Tinting your home’s windows is a great option if you’re looking for an effective way to improve home insulation. Find out how to improve insulation in your house with window tinting below along with some of the other great benefits.

Tint a Home specialises in home window tinting and is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and offer a lifetime warranty on most of our films. Here is how to improve insulation in your house with window tinting:

How to Improve House Insulation with Window Tinting

When the weather is cold, heat escapes from your windows. Window film becomes a form of insulation, acting as a barrier to keep the cold out and the heat in. Because window film reflects the sun’s rays it is not only an effective way to improve insulation in your house, it also keeps your home cooler in the warmer months too. And there are some other great benefits to tinting your home windows, depending on the type of film you choose, including:

  • Protection for you and your family from the harmful UV rays
  • Protection for your floorings and furnishings from fading
  • Increased privacy without losing natural light or your view
  • A safer and secure home with our security film that holds shattered glass together slowing entry into your home for unwanted visitors (and making your home safer if the glass is broken accidentally)

We also have lighter shades of film available so you can still enjoy the benefits of window tinting without altering the appearance of your home. All our window films come with a lifetime warranty for residential applications and are government certified by ARPANSA.

Find your nearest store using our Store Finder to speak with your local window tinting experts about how to improve insulation in your house or call 13 TINT to speak with our friendly and knowledgeable customer service team – they’ll be able to answer any questions you have on how to improve home insulation with window film.
